newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Yukong delays 265,000-bpd CDU operation.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Yukong delays 265,000-bpd CDU operation.

text.p: Yukong Ltd's 265,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) is expected to resume operations on November 20, six days later than previously scheduled, company officials said on Tuesday.
They said the refiner had initially shut down the unit for maintenance on October 21, six days after the refiner had announced the shut down.
The officials said they have delayed the maintenance for reasons of convenience.
Yukong, the nation's largest oil refiner, has a refining capability of 810,000 bpd.
